But now the hard part. Cleaning house to start fresh.

Have you ever cleaned a house? I don't mean your spring cleaning, I don't mean your daily/weekly/monthly pick up, I mean *really clean* - usually someone else's space: your teenage son's room, when he can no longer pull the door shut because there is so much shit everywhere; the house you bought 'as is' that was so cheap because the old owner was a hoarder and the bank didn't want to deal with that shit; the home of a loved one after they pass away.
